trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum trophy and is awarded automatically once you have earned every other trophy in the game. There is nothing extra to do beyond completing the full list. It unlocks the moment the final remaining trophy pops, so just keep working through the roadmap.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the game. Simply play through the prologue until the mission ends; it is impossible to miss. This is the first story trophy you will earn.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unlocked by completing every mission in Chapter 1. Just follow the story naturally; none of the chapter trophies can be missed. Chapter 1 is entirely linear, so this will come without any extra effort.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded when you finish all missions in Chapter 2. Story progression is automatic, so this trophy cannot be missed. Keep playing the main missions and it will pop at the end of the chapter.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unlocked upon completing Chapter 3 of the main story. Like the other chapter trophies, it is unmissable and tied to linear story progress. Simply finish the final mission of the chapter.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 4. This is part of the unmissable story chain and requires only that you keep playing. The trophy pops as soon as the chapter's last mission completes.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: This gold trophy is awarded for completing the final mission of the game. It is the last story-related trophy and cannot be missed, as finishing the story is mandatory. Once it pops you are free to roam and clean up everything else.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission early in the game. Complete it to earn the trophy; it cannot be missed as it is required for story progression. Just follow the mission markers until it finishes.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a major story heist mission. It is unmissable and completed as part of the main campaign. Play through the setup and the heist itself and the trophy will unlock.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission you complete during the campaign. It cannot be missed since it is part of the critical path. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission completed during the mid-to-late campaign. It is unmissable and tied to story progression. Simply finish the mission when it becomes available.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission in the later part of the game. It is part of the critical path and cannot be missed. Complete the mission to unlock the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is one of the final story missions. It is unmissable and completed near the end of the campaign. Finish the operation and the trophy will pop.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This gold trophy requires reaching 100% completion, which means finishing the story plus all side activities, collectibles, and challenges the game tracks. Nothing in it is permanently missable, since everything remains accessible after the story. Expect this to be the last or second-to-last trophy you earn, alongside the platinum.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: You must complete 250 stunts of any type across Leonida. Stunts include jumps, flips, and other aerial vehicle tricks, and they accumulate naturally as you drive around. To speed it up, find a ramp or hill you like and repeat jumps until the counter hits 250.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: You need to try each of the activity types in the game once, and there are several spread across the map. Activities include things like racing, fishing, arcade games, bowling, and shooting range challenges. Just sample each one; you do not need to win or complete them fully.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: This is a grind: you must earn a gold medal in every shooting range challenge in the game. There are dozens of challenges, and gold usually requires high accuracy and fast completion. Practice each challenge, learn the target layouts, and upgrade your weapons to make the score requirements easier.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races are held at multiple locations around the map, and you must win at least one race at each of them. Find the race markers, enter a drone race, and finish first. Winning at every location is the requirement, so keep racing until each site is checked off.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: You must win 20 different races around Leonida. Races are marked on the map and rotate through various vehicle classes. Keep entering and winning new races and the trophy will unlock after your twentieth victory.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is a fishing opponent you can challenge at a fishing spot in Leonida. Talk to him, start the challenge, and catch a bigger or better fish than he does. Upgrading your fishing gear and picking the right spot makes this much easier.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine in Leonida and play one of the arcade games until you complete it. Arcades are located in specific venues around the map. You only need to finish one game, so pick whichever you enjoy most.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the side characters with his own mission strand. You must complete all of his missions through to the final one. This is potentially missable, so finish Andy's strand before completing the final story mission.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton has a side mission strand that ends with a boat-related finale. Complete every mission in his strand to unlock this trophy. Because side strands can become unavailable after certain story points, do this before the end of the game.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's strand is a series of side missions ending in a final mission. Work through all of Billy's missions to earn the trophy. As with the other character strands, it is safest to complete it before finishing the story.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: You must complete eight full mission strands given by stranger characters scattered across Leonida. Each strand has multiple missions, so this takes a while. The strands can be missed if you progress too far in the story, so prioritize them during the mid-game.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy is a side character whose strand ends with a supply-related final mission. Finish his entire mission line to unlock this trophy. Complete it before the story ends, as the strand is missable.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's side mission strand concludes with a final mission you must complete. Play through all of his missions in order. Like the other character strands, this one is missable, so do not leave it until after the story.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are meditation spots scattered across Leonida, and you must meditate at every one of them. The spots are marked once discovered, and you can revisit them anytime. Fast travel or drive around the map and meditate at each location to clear the list.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is a hunting enthusiast who asks you to track down a unique animal. Accept his mission, find the animal in the wild, and take it down. The mission is tied to Bret's strand, so complete it before the story ends to avoid missing it.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden in sets around Leonida, and you must complete three full sets. Each set requires finding every card in it, so explore thoroughly and check every nook of the map. Cards remain collectible after the story, so take your time.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It is a location-based activity you can perform at spots all over Leonida, and you need to do it at 100 of them. The locations are spread across the whole map, so this is a long exploration grind. Nothing locks you out, so clean it up whenever you like.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are optional objectives such as stunts, kills, or collection tasks that you can complete while free roaming. You must finish 50 of them in total. They accumulate naturally, but you can speed things up by actively hunting easy challenges on the map.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Commit enough crimes to reach a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the police and escape. Breaking line of sight and hiding works best. The trophy pops once the wanted level is fully cleared.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, rob three shops in a row without letting your wanted level drop between robberies. Move quickly between nearby shops so the police do not lose track of you. Plan a route of three close stores before you start.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: You must discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Getting into a vehicle for the first time registers it as discovered, so steal or borrow everything you see. Vary the vehicle types and locations to fill out the list faster.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming ability you can trigger in combat. You must take down five enemies during a single use of it. Wait for a group of enemies, activate Combat Focus, and quickly take down five of them before it ends.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: During the VCIA story segment, you get a chance to leave in a way that was not part of the plan. Take the unscheduled exit when the opportunity arises. Because this only happens at a specific story moment, it is easy to miss, so act when prompted.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the military tanks that appear when you reach the maximum wanted level. Survive or deal with the tanks during a max-wanted rampage to earn this trophy. Trigger a five-star wanted level near open ground and take on the Rhinos.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: You must rob a jewelry store without any guard or camera detecting you. Scope out the store first, avoid the sightlines, and move quietly during the robbery. If you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: You must rob five different bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank robberies are multi-step, involving getting in, cracking the vault, and losing the police on the way out. Bring good weapons and a fast escape vehicle for each job.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck, stop it, rob it, and escape the responding police. Trucks follow set routes, so wait for one at a good ambush spot. Block the road, take the cash, and drive off before the heat arrives.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: You must explore every area of Leonida to unlock this trophy. Driving through each district registers it as explored, so take a grand tour of the map. Nothing is locked after the story, so you can do this at your own pace.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Each gang in Leonida runs illegal operations, and you must rob one operation belonging to each gang. Find the gang businesses on the map and hit one from every faction. Expect heavy resistance, so come prepared for a fight.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach early in the game and buy a cocktail at a spot with a view. Sit back and watch the moment play out. This is a relaxed, story-flavored trophy you can grab right after the prologue.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Find a vehicle showroom, get into a car inside, and smash your way out through the windows. The classic style means making a dramatic exit through the glass. Any showroom works, so drive in and crash out.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a game of bowling. The trophy references a classic follow-through, so complete the bowling activity while you are there. It is a quick, fun break from the main game.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This trophy is tied to a big partnership moment between the two protagonists. It unlocks as you play through the story and partnership content. Keep progressing the campaign and it will come naturally.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The game tracks the choices you make throughout the story, and this trophy requires a large number of them. You accumulate choices by making decisions in missions and dialogue over the course of the game. By the time you finish the story and side content, you should have made plenty.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: This trophy is awarded when you succeed at something on your second attempt. Fail a scripted activity once, then try again and succeed. The exact trigger is a story moment, so just keep playing and it will come up.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This trophy is tied to a strange, otherworldly event you can witness in a specific location. Travel to the remote spot where the odd occurrence happens and watch the scene. Because it is a one-time event in a hidden location, it is easy to miss, so seek it out before finishing everything.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by means swinging a melee weapon at someone from a moving vehicle. Drive up beside a pedestrian or enemy at low speed and swing your weapon to knock them down. Timing is easier at slow speeds, so do not rush.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies, and you launder them through contacts who take a cut. You must launder a total of $250,000 through your contacts over the course of the game. Keep robbing stores, trucks, and banks to build up a supply of marked bills.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: You must spend $100,000 total in shops around Leonida. Buy clothes, food, weapons, or whatever the shops sell until you hit the total. Earning money is the slow part, so rob and launder to fund your shopping spree.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Garages are properties you can buy to store vehicles, and you must purchase all of them. Save up your money and visit each garage location to buy it. Properties stay available, so you can buy them whenever you can afford them.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles for rental income. Open the app, select a vehicle you own or have access to, and register it. Do this with ten different vehicles and the trophy is yours.
trophies.sources: Official PlayStation trophy description; PSNProfiles GTA VI guide; Exophase
